log_tail: - Thermal Reliefs: Spoked connections for vias or pins that connect to the plane, facilitating soldering.
2. Why Signal Wires/Traces are Banned:

- Destroyed Return Paths: High-speed signals on adjacent layers couple to the solid plane below/above as return paths. Crossing a trace gap detours return currents, causing severe EMI and signal integrity issues.
- Compromised Power Delivery: Power planes should provide the lowest impedance path. Routing traces chops up the copper, creating bottleneck restrictions and voltage drops.
